title: Crispy Chicken Quesadillas
description: A flavorful twist on traditional quesadillas, with crispy chicken and melted cheese.
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together flour, paprika, cumin, and cayenne pepper (if using).
Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Dredge chicken in flour mixture, shaking off excess.
In a separate dish, beat eggs. Dip floured chicken in eggs, then coat in flour mixture again.
Heat 1/2-inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Fry chicken until golden brown and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Transfer fried chicken to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, warm tortillas over medium heat for 1-2 minutes on each side.
Place a tortilla in the skillet, sprinkle with cheese, and top with a piece of fried chicken.
Fold tortilla in half to enclose filling. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until tortilla is crispy and cheese is melted.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling.
Cut quesadillas into wedges and serve with chopped cilantro and your favorite toppings.
